Paper 1.12: Evaluate (12 marks): AO1 knowledge and understanding = 4 marks; AO2 analysis/evaluation = 8 marks. Level 1 (1–3): isolated knowledge, superficial analysis, asserted judgements. Level 2 (4–6): limited understanding, some developed arguments, simple judgements and limited justification. Level 3 (7–9): accurate understanding, logical chains of reasoning across different views, reasoned judgements and a partially justified conclusion. Level 4 (10–12): sustained, accurate and thorough knowledge; coherent logical analysis of different views; appraisal of arguments; justified conclusion consistent with the analysis.
Paper 1.3: Identify (3 marks): award 1 mark for each valid factual point, up to 3. No development is required for the point to receive its identification mark. Accept other valid responses; do not credit repetition.
Paper 1.4: Outline (4 marks): normally two distinct points, each with a relevant description (1) and development (1). Development must relate to the point and the question; do not award repeated development.
Paper 1.6: Explain (6 marks): AO1 knowledge and understanding = 3 marks; AO2 explanation/analysis of significance and influence = 3 marks. Best-fit levels: 1–2 limited/superficial; 3–4 mostly accurate and developed; 5–6 accurate, comprehensive understanding with well-developed explanation and judgements.

Paper 2.10: Discuss (10 marks): AO1 knowledge and understanding = 4 marks; AO2 analysis = 6 marks. Level 1 (1–3): isolated knowledge and superficial analysis with little consideration of how aspects interrelate. Level 2 (4–6): limited understanding and basic analysis with some developed arguments but limited interrelation. Level 3 (7–8): accurate understanding and logical reasoning considering different aspects and how they interrelate. Level 4 (9–10): sustained accurate and thorough knowledge; coherent logical reasoning considering different aspects and their interrelationships in a sustained way.
Paper 2.4: Outline (4 marks): normally two relevant points, each with a description (1) and development (1). Development must relate to the point and question. Credit any other valid Christian response; do not reward repetition or unrelated development.
Paper 2.6: Explain (6 marks): AO1 knowledge and understanding = 3 marks; AO2 analysis of significance/influence = 3 marks. Best-fit levels: 1–2 limited/superficial; 3–4 mostly accurate and developed; 5–6 accurate, comprehensive understanding with well-developed explanation and judgements.
